info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Case Instances API

items.docs:
The request body can contain all possible filters that can be used in the List case instances URL query. On top of these, it’s possible to provide an array of variables to include in the query, with their format described here.

The general paging and sorting query-parameters can be used for this URL.

params.name: id
params.description: Only return case instances with the given id.

params.name: ids
params.description: Only return case instances with the given comma-separated ids.

params.name: caseDefinitionKey
params.description: Only return case instances with the given case definition key.

params.name: caseDefinitionKeyLike
params.description: Only return case instances like given case definition key.

params.name: caseDefinitionKeyLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances like given case definition key, ignoring case.

params.name: caseDefinitionId
params.description: Only return case instances with the given case definition id.

params.name: caseDefinitionCategory
params.description: Only return case instances with the given case definition category.

params.name: caseDefinitionCategoryLike
params.description: Only return case instances like the given case definition category.

params.name: caseDefinitionCategoryLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances like the given case definition category, ignoring case.

params.name: caseDefinitionName
params.description: Only return case instances with the given case definition name.

params.name: caseDefinitionNameLike
params.description: Only return case instances like the given case definition name.

params.name: caseDefinitionNameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances like the given case definition name, ignoring case.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return case instances with the given name.

params.name: nameLike
params.description: Only return case instances like the given name.

params.name: nameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances like the given name ignoring case.

params.name: rootScopeId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given root scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: parentScopeId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given parent scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: businessKey
params.description: Only return case instances with the given business key.

params.name: businessKeyLike
params.description: Only return case instances like the given business key.

params.name: businessKeyLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances like the given business key, ignoring case.

params.name: businessStatus
params.description: Only return case instances with the given business status.

params.name: businessStatusLike
params.description: Only return case instances like the given business status.

params.name: businessStatusLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances like the given business status, ignoring case.

params.name: caseInstanceParentId
params.description: Only return case instances with the given parent id.

params.name: startedBy
params.description: Only return case instances started by the given user.

params.name: startedBefore
params.description: Only return case instances started before the given date.

params.name: startedAfter
params.description: Only return case instances started after the given date.

params.name: state
params.description: Only return case instances with the given state.

params.name: callbackId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given callback id.

params.name: callbackIds
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given callback ids.

params.name: callbackType
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given callback type.

params.name: parentCaseInstanceId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given parent case instance id.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given reference id.

params.name: referenceType
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given reference type.

params.name: lastReactivatedBy
params.description: Only return case instances last reactivated by the given user.

params.name: lastReactivatedBefore
params.description: Only return case instances last reactivated before the given date.

params.name: lastReactivatedAfter
params.description: Only return case instances last reactivated after the given date.

params.name: includeCaseVariables
params.description: Indication to include case variables in the result.

params.name: includeCaseVariablesName
params.description: Indication to include case variables with the given names in the result.

params.name: activePlanItemDefinitionId
params.description: Only return case instances that have an active plan item instance with the given plan item definition id.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return case instances with the given tenantId.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return case instances with a tenantId like the given value.

params.name: tenantIdLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return case instances with a tenantId like the given value, ignoring case.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns case instances without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

items.docs:
Note that also a *transientVariables* property is accepted as part of this json, that follows the same structure as the *variables* property.

Only one of *caseDefinitionId* or *caseDefinitionKey* an be used in the request body.

Parameters *businessKey*, *variables* and *tenantId* are optional.

If tenantId is omitted, the default tenant will be used.

 It is possible to send variables, transientVariables and startFormVariables in one request.
